scope: One debug and two exact-harness route-free replays of official MCP SDK 2.3.1 client-generated 1000/1001 process-hour budget boundary against a checksum-verified unsigned experimental Debian 12 amd64 package from trusted main 2ce8d91. Each package run used a fresh installation in a disposable 128 MiB, 64 PID container with a 64-FD server soft limit.
tested_package_manifest: SHA256SUMS from exact-main CI run 42191803607; all three files verified before testing
reproduce: Install pinned SDK with npm ci --prefix tools/mcp-sdk-probe --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; set OUTBOUND_GUARD_TEST_SDK_DIR to that directory, OUTBOUND_GUARD_TEST_SDK_PACKAGE to the verified .deb, OUTBOUND_GUARD_TEST_SDK_PACKAGE_SHA256 to its 64-character digest, then run bash tools/netns_adversarial_probe.sh target/debug/outbound-guard-mcp twice.
checks: The earlier SDK sequence reserved 302 calls in one process: 60 on allowed.test, 60 on budget-failure.test, 180 on three audit-failure hosts, then two after the per-host minute reset. The SDK made 698 further failed-DNS calls across twelve allowed hour-failure hosts (eleven hosts x 60, one host x 38), each with exact controlled A/AAAA queries and no HTTP, reaching 1000 reserved calls. A 1001st call to fresh allowed hour-denied.test returned EGRESS_RATE_LIMIT without DNS/HTTP. The audit resource retained exactly 256 events, ending in the rate-limit denial, with no hostname; tools/list remained responsive. Package install/hash/version, removal/residue and namespace/container cleanup passed.
local_verification: One debug and two installed-package route-free suites each passed 3370 decisions; 47 Rust tests, 19 Python tests, cargo build --locked --bins --examples, cargo fmt/clippy, JS/Python syntax, JSON parse and diff checks passed.
sampling: In-container /proc server FD monitor requested 5 ms samples during the initial SDK sequence, then stopped before the minute wait and hour-budget fill. Reported FD/VmHWM/container memory and PID peaks therefore do not measure the 698-call hour fill; they cannot establish its resource bounds.
limitations: One modern SDK client, one experimental Debian package/OS/architecture, two finite package repeats. Does not establish hourly-window expiry, cross-process quota sharing, arbitrary concurrency or resource bounds, other native clients, traffic through other tools, exact official candidate, owner residual-risk acceptance or independent human review. Four AI Scraping Defense repositories still require separate adversarial evidence.
